basis: User authorized iterative local training. This explicitly scoped 10-update pilot supersedes earlier non-approval only for the exact filtered mixture and checkpoint above. It tests a small reviewed mixture with actual coverage tracking and multi-turn regression monitoring; it does not certify the individual records or authorize a larger run.
review_and_isolation: Wikipedia excerpts were selected by two sequential model reviews; Wikivoyage excerpts by one model reviewer per sample. Thirteen records sharing 20-character windows with two fixed historical training sources were removed; paraphrases and other historical or final-test overlap are not excluded.
limitations: No human review or independent fact checking. Some passages may be inaccurate, stale, biased, technical or stylistically narrow.

Wikipedia and Wikivoyage source declarations include CC BY-SA; individual page history, translation and third-party rights have not been fully established. Preserve attribution and do not distribute this data as a cleared dataset.
The 170 passages contain 27906 next-token targets. With-replacement draws can repeat them; report unique positions and repeated exposure, not as independent new knowledge.
The source labeled story by the existing trainer is a mixed encyclopedia and travel sample, not a story corpus. Existing old pretraining material is separately limited by P107 review.
The final test remains untouched. Generation metrics do not establish usefulness or chat ability.
